I address Trump's pending deal with Iran and the meltdown of the warmongers in this piece. But while Israel's supporters openly attack Trump, Israeli officials may keep a lower profile given Israel's elections and Trump's ability to hurt them politically in Israel.

But make no mistake, if a deal is reached, it will be a major strategic defeat for Israel.

Israel’s two wars have, paradoxically, strengthened Iran’s deterrence posture, exposed Israel’s inability to confront Iran without overwhelmi

The regional role in the US-Iran deal is astounding. 
1) Many regional states actively helped reach a resolution.
2) Their support protects Trump from domestic criticisms and takes attention away from Israel's opposition.
3) The regional anchoring ensures greater durability.

Video

.@AJEnglish asked me if Trump could have achieved the same outcome without war. What the war did, in my view, was that the US came to realize that war does not work and, as a result, the US needed a deal that ensured long-term peace. That's the impact of having tried war.

Video

Trump just announced a pending deal with Iran, and I spoke to @PKurzin on the meaning of it, whether it is a loss for the US or a win, the risks Trump will face in the phase II negotiations, and what happens next:

piped.video/watch?v=auvOADLj…

It should be noted that Trump only said that the Strait should be open. He never said anything about who would control it. 

I see no difference between the US and Iranian public statements. Only different emphasis on the various details of the agreement.

The warmongers and the pro-Israel crowd have been freaking out for the past 36h publicly. With Trump announcing a deal just now, the freakout will crescendo.

Netanyahu will likely be more muted publicly. He cannot afford to confront Trump publicly, particularly not as he is gearing up for elections.

But the voices in Washington that often act as his proxy will be loud, desperate, and reeking of despair.

BREAKING! 

Trump announces, after having had phone calls with the leaders of Saudi, UAE, Qatar, Pakistan, Turkey, Egypt, Jordan, and Bahrain - and separately with Israel - a deal between the US and Iran, subject to final approval, has essentially been reached. 

If you were wondering why warmongers in Washington have been freaking out, it's because of this: Peace is their nightmare.
